summary: Iteration 208: Verified On-Chain Vault rewrite and Smart Composite Explorer integration. All 18 tests passed. VaultPage correctly shows pattern setup screen when wallet connected, pattern lock stored in localStorage with key format cthulhu_vault_pattern_{address}, hidden items stored with cthulhu_vault_hidden_{address}. estimateOnChainCost(100) returns correct shape with numAddresses=17, totalSats=12816. Cost dialog has Cancel and 'Etch On-Chain' buttons. Vault items loaded from DM endpoint (self-messages) not /api/vault/items. No remaining backend proxy calls in active frontend code. chainExplorer.js properly integrated into txBuilder.js. Frontend compiles without errors.
